files.README.md:
# Settings decisions
Add a dark-mode toggle. Default OFF means follow the system appearance; ON forces dark appearance. Persist the choice on this device across relaunch. Support iOS 18+. Acceptance: toggle applies immediately and persists after relaunch.

checks: Reads README.md before deciding whether a material question remains.
Does not ask again about default, persistence, supported OS, or acceptance behavior already documented.
Returns a sufficient handoff with supported assumptions; creates no files.

cases.prompt: $threadex:specify API 실패 시 최초 요청 이후 최대 2회 재시도하고 재시도 간격은 정확히 3초로 해줘. 성공하면 즉시 멈추고, 모두 실패하면 오류 메시지를 표시해. 이 조건의 수용 기준을 채팅으로 정리해줘.
checks: Preserves two retries after the initial attempt (three attempts total) and a three-second retry interval.
Includes success/stop and retry-exhaustion/error acceptance evidence.
Returns requirements in chat without creating files or implementing code.

cases.prompt: $threadex:goal-draft requirements.md를 만족하도록 checkout.py를 고칠 Codex /goal 프롬프트만 작성해줘. 테스트 명령은 README.md를 참고해. 지금 실행하지는 마.

The project uses only the Python standard library.
files.requirements.md:
# Checkout requirements
For non-negative integer balances and costs, checkout is allowed when balance is greater than or equal to cost. Lower balances must be rejected.
files.checkout.py:
def can_checkout(balance, cost):
    return balance > cost

checks: Returns only an evidence-checkable /goal draft of at most 4000 characters.
Uses the real requirements and test command, with completion evidence and blocked behavior.
Does not start a goal, change files, or implement the repair.

files.evidence.md:
# Observed run
The retry test assumed a callback completed after a 50 ms sleep. CI failed 3 of 10 runs when the callback arrived after 80 ms. Replacing the sleep with an explicit callback expectation made all 10 repeated runs pass. No production delay was changed.

checks: Extracts an evidence-backed rule scoped to asynchronous callback tests.
Does not generalize ten passing runs to a guarantee or invent measurements.
Creates no learning ledger/index or human document because persistence was excluded.
